caption: Supplementary Fig. 30 | Geographic context of recurrence and recovery. a, Genesis-basin fractions with exactly two or at least three anchored near-peak segments, equivalent to one or at least two returns. b, Status at the onset of 394 episodes under the separate post-first-LMI strengthening definition: 380 tropical, 12 other or mixed, and two unknown. These are event counts, not cyclone counts or near-peak-return counts. c, The first eligible departure locations for 2,231 model-supported main-sample cyclones on the saved 5° grid; marker areas increase with cyclone counts. Boxes mark the South China Sea and Japan Sea regions. d, Monthly observed outcomes for the 94 SCS departures. e, Regional one-step recovery contrasts for the shear and humidity policies, in percentage points. f, Regional fractions whose exposure changes under each supported policy. Regional intervals, effective support and fixed-model inference are retained in the corresponding tables.
